title: Light Sensor
introduction:
The light sensor sits on top of the instrument panel near the windshield, above the center vents in the illustration. I use the wide view to locate it and the close-up to understand the connector beneath it. The trick is to lift the sensor out of its mounting first, then disconnect it—the wiring is a tether, not a lifting handle.

Have a non-marring tool ready for the release. This procedure covers removal and refitting; it provides no electrical test or lighting-response check.

items.name: Non-marring tool
items.detail: Use it to release the sensor from the instrument panel at the illustrated location.

edits.text: Use a non-marring tool to release the light sensor from its mounting at the illustrated location, then lift the sensor upward.
edits.why: The raised position exposes the connector underneath. The specified tool helps protect the surrounding instrument panel surface during release.

edits.text: Release the electrical connector latch shown in the close-up, disconnect the connector and remove the light sensor.
edits.why: The close-up identifies the connector release beneath the sensor. Disconnecting it frees the sensor from the vehicle wiring.

edits.text: Reverse the removal sequence: reconnect the electrical connector, then lower the light sensor into its mounting and engage its retaining features.
edits.why: Reassembly restores both the electrical connection and the sensor’s seated position in the instrument panel.
